bio: The Auberge de l'Ill is much more than just a restaurant. It embodies the Alsatian inn in all its glory – an inviting and friendly place, untouched by the passage of time, where every customer is welcomed like a member of the family… It is an institution in the region, but also renowned throughout France and beyond! Since it was established in 1882 (between Sélestat and Riquewihr), the restaurant has made a name for itself thanks to its matelote with riesling and dishes based on local game. Marc Haeberlin, grandson of the founders, now serves the classical repertoire (foie gras terrine served by the spoonful, frog’s leg mousseline, salmon soufflé) alongside more modern creations. The legend lives on....
